==Background==
"'''Melt'''" is an original song by ryo featuring Hatsune Miku. The song is about a shy girl who is in love with a boy. In her pursuit of him, she gets her bangs cut and encourages herself to look cute, all the while hoping he'd notice. Her love is pure; she loves him not because she is in love with being in love, but because she genuinely likes him, to such an extent she can't even bring herself to look him in the eye and feels like melting to simply be with him.

Later that day, it rains. Since the weather report was inaccurate, the girl is caught off-guard; while she does have a collapsible umbrella in her bag, she thinks it is too small. The boy therefore invites her to join him under his own umbrella. With her heart pounding, she is so happy she could cry, because in Japan sharing an umbrella is a sign of shared feelings and is associated with couples. When they reach the station, she almost tells him to hold her because she does not want to leave him, and can not believe herself.

Multiple [[Vocaloid Fanmade Promotion Video|Fanmade PVs]] for "Melt" exist; most of them feature Miku as the protagonist, acting out the events described by the song. The "boyfriend" character is often represented by a faceless person (a technique often used to represent "Master", or the VOCALOID user). The most known version of the PV depicts KAITO as the boyfriend.

On January 22, 2026, ryo would upload a brand new arrangement for the song subtitled "'''CPK! Remix'''" in celebration of the release of the anime film ''[https://www.cho-kaguyahime.com/ Cosmic Princess Kaguya!]'', for which he contributed to the film's soundtrack. A cover of this remix was featured in the film as a special credits track. This remix was also ryo's first usage of Hatsune Miku in 10 years since "[[罪の名前 (Tsumi no Namae)|Tsumi no Namae]]". It has since entered the ''Hall of Fame'' and exceeded 10 million views on YouTube.

===Popularity===
"Melt" and its PVs are so popular on NicoNico and YouTube that it has been featured in some [[wikipedia:Kumikyoku Nico Nico Douga|Nico Nico Medleys]], and has many covers and parodies both by live musicians and other [[VOCALOID]]s.

With over fourteen million views, the original upload of "Melt" on Niconico is the third most viewed original VOCALOID song on the site, behind "[[Senbonzakura]]" and "[[Miku Miku ni Shite Ageru♪]]". It isn't quite as popular on YouTube, although one reprint of the 3M Mix of "Melt" has over five million views. This puts it far behind other VOCALOID YouTube reuploads such as "[[Matryoshka]]" and "[[World is Mine]]". In addition, the song has entered the [[Hall of Fame|Hall of Myths]] on Niconico.

|-|Approved English lyrics =
{{Translation|jpn|unofficial English|Project DIVA|notes=Featured in [[Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- F 2nd]], the writer is uncredited.}}
<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
When I woke up this morning
The first thing I thought of was you
I made up my mind, and cut my bangs short
Just so you'd ask me "Why?"

Pink skirt, flower pin in my hair
I'm going out
I'm looking cute today!

Melt! I feel like I'm gonna melt away
I can't tell you I like you, but then I...
Melt! I can't even look you in the eye
I won't fall for love, not me
But... I really do like you

I wish time would stop
I feel like I could cry
So happy, I feel like I could die!

Melt! Pulling into the station
The end of the line for us, so near, so far
Melt! I want to hold your hand in mine
Do we already have to say goodbye?
I want you to take me in your arms!
...You wish!
</poem>
|-|Official English lyrics =
{{Translation|jpn|official English|Producer|Featured in "CPK! Remix", translated by LUSCHKA}}
<poem style="margin-left:1em;">
Melting, my heart is melting over you

First thing in the morning
Before I even open up my eyes you're the one upon my mind
Standing in front of the mirror I trim my bangs a little shorter
Just to see if you would ask me why

With a flower pin, a skirt of pink
Heading out the door, thinking of you
Don't you think I'm pretty too? I hope you do!

Melting, my heart is melting over you
What if I love you? I think I do, but I won't tell you
There is no way... Melting, I can't even look you in the eye
I'm not the kind of girl who falls in love with love, no lie

The only truth I keep deep inside... It's you I love

Weatherman, he lied today, sun has gone away
Sky is turning grey, pouring rain gets in the way
A folded umbrella, left unused in my bag, it's such a drag
I let out a sign into the air, and that's when you―

"I guess I'll let you share with me"
You smile and laugh right next to me looking pleased and carefree
And I've heard the sound of falling, loud and clear

Melting, I just can't breathe because of you
My hand is trembling when it brushes yours, you're too close to my right side
Sharing one small umbrella, me and you
My heart is pounding hard like never before, what am I waiting for?

I wish my heart could find its way to yours!

If I could stop the clock, don't let it fly, I'm about to cry
But joy is louder, don't know why, I'm so happy I could die!

Melting, the station lights come into sight...
Our time is up tonight, you're by my side, yet worlds apart, so please
Melting, I wanna hold your hand in mine!
Time to say goodbye? doesn't feel right, just hold me tight!

Can I ask you to wrap your arms around me now?
...no, never mind.
</poem>

====Summer Sonic Festival 2013====
Hatsune Miku performed as the opening act during the "Summer Sonic Festival 2013" event in Tokyo, Japan. Miku performed [[Tell Your World]], [[二息歩行 (Nisoku Hokou)|Nisoku Hokou]], [[Yellow]], [[トリノコシティ (Torinoko City)|Torinoko City]], [[秘密警察 (Himitsu Keisatsu)|Himitsu Keisatsu]], [[初音ミクの激唱 (Hatsune Miku no Gekishou)|Hatsune Miku no Gekishou]], and "Melt".
